title: Hooray for Librarians
content: Here are Nallab and Enit, Dinotopia’s librarians. Tell me in the comments if a library or a librarian helped make you who you are. For me, the Brand library in Glendale, California was the lifeline to early art instruction books that I used to teach myself in the pre-internet era.----fromDinotopia: A Land Apart from Timesigned on my website. Alsoavailable on Amazon
